_doc: Spec 009: Main-process files that may differ from the spec 008 base (8130c17), each with its reason. check-desktop-baseline fails on any other change under electron/.

files.source/app/platforms/electron/chunking/b: T011: @types/node types a Worker 'error' as unknown; message read the same way for an Error (type-only)
files.source/app/platforms/electron/ipc/overla: T011: same, the worker error is passed on as an Error (type-only)
files.source/app/platforms/electron/config/clo: T022: the config folder moved to source/core/src/config (path of cloud-oauth-secrets.json / client_secret_*.json only)
files.source/app/platforms/electron/config/goo: T022: the config folder moved to source/core/src/config (path of cloud-oauth-secrets.json / client_secret_*.json only)
files.source/app/platforms/electron/host-adapt: T024: moved here from the SDK folder unchanged (imports of the core re-pointed; two eslint-disable comments for rules it was not linted by before)
T024: import path of host-adapters (moved into electron/)
files.source/app/platforms/electron/translatio: T024: import path of host-adapters (moved into electron/)
files.source/app/platforms/electron/persistenc: T027: getSqlDriver() hands out the core SyncSqlDriver over the same connection (no store changed)
T029: the 30 migrations moved byte-identical to source/core/src/db/desktop/migrations (hashes in desktop-migrations.sha256.json)
T029: the ?raw imports read the migrations from their new folder (list and order unchanged)
T032: SQL and row codecs come from core (libraryStatements / libraryCodec), run through the SyncSqlDriver; control flow and transactions unchanged

T033: SQL and note_json codecs come from core (overlayStatements / overlayCodec), run through the SyncSqlDriver; the manual BEGIN IMMEDIATE blocks are driver.transaction(…, immediate); behaviour unchanged
T034: SQL and row codec come from core (txtStatements / txtCodec), run through the SyncSqlDriver; commit keeps its own immediate transaction
T035: SQL and the Notes rules come from core (audioStatements / audioCodec), run through the SyncSqlDriver; behaviour unchanged
T036: SQL, row codecs and limits come from core (transcriptStatements / transcriptCodec), run through the SyncSqlDriver; commitWindow keeps its single transaction
files.source/app/platforms/electron/theme/titl: T038: comment only (the stylesheet moved to source/app/styles)
files.source/app/platforms/electron/pdf-sync/t: T047: the fallback root (used only when APP_ROOT is unset) is one folder up, because electron/ is now the host folder itself
